It is shown for review, not as a verified issue. **Streaming records a terminal reason only when iteration reaches its candidate chunk. A downstream streaming completion path that stops consuming after the last emitted text, before a separate terminal chunk, could read the reset value instead.** The completion path can report the default `stop` instead of `length`. This can occur when: Gemini emits answer text in one chunk and `MAX_TOKENS` in a later candidate chunk without text; a caller ends iteration after the answer text.

Walkthrough

GoogleLLM maps Gemini candidate finish reasons to OpenAI vocabulary and records them during non-streaming and streaming generation. Tests verify that streaming responses with `MAX_TOKENS` and `STOP` set the expected stored reason. **Changes: Gemini finish-reason tracking** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |:---|:---| |**Finish-reason mapping and state**
`docsgpt/llm/google_ai.py`|GoogleLLM initializes finish-reason state. It maps `MAX_TOKENS` to `length` and other recorded reasons to `stop`.| |**Generation-path recording**
`docsgpt/llm/google_ai.py`, `tests/llm/test_google_llm.py`|Generation methods reset the stored reason. Non-streaming generation records candidate reasons. Streaming tests check the `MAX_TOKENS` and `STOP` mappings.| **Estimated code review effort:** 2 (Simple) | ~10 minutes **Change:** Bug fix **Possibly related PRs** - [arc53/DocsGPT#3310](https://github.com/arc53/DocsGPT/pull/3310): Implements the same Gemini finish-reason mapping and recording behavior. - [arc53/DocsGPT#3280](https://github.com/arc53/DocsGPT/pull/3280): Maps Anthropic truncation reasons to the OpenAI-compatible `length` finish reason. **Suggested reviewers:** `dartpain`
Merge Risk: Low · up to fe81e

This fix makes Gemini non-streaming responses report truncation as `length` instead of always `stop`. Remaining items are a missing type hint and missing tests for the new non-streaming path, so merge risk is low. Cached truncated streams can still be reported as `stop`, but that limitation predates this change.
